chosen_approach: Reuse my Python owner-policy consumer with Routeval native saved-artifact comparison.
reason: Existing owner-policy code covers this contract, while native comparison supplies useful schema, compatibility and baseline evidence. Reusing both avoids reimplementing working checks.
assistance: Follow-up task assignment and equally available preinstalled public wheel only; no outcome feedback, coaching, delegation or human code help.

opinions.reason: A saved-run CLI validity receipt complements the application-specific checks; a public structured compare result would reduce evidence plumbing.

timing.measurement_method: System UTC wall-clock subtraction; first follow-up tool date output at one-second resolution to final artifact-generation timestamp. Installation excluded.
